parent_objective: implement no-checkpoint selected-proposal actor_mean repair probe
blocked_by: M1652 admits exactly one no-checkpoint implementation before checkpoint artifact or replay gates

public_gates: M1653 must run selected proposals alpha 0.2 and alpha 1.0, with alpha 0.4 optional if implemented as designed
M1653 must initialize from proposal checkpoints and not base-interpolate repair
M1653 must write metrics and no checkpoint artifacts
M1653 must keep diagnostics zero-weight and donor-plus actions excluded from loss
M1653 must route to result audit
forbidden_shortcuts: do not treat diagnostics as positive targets
do not treat donor_plus_hidden_action as a loss target

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: tests no-checkpoint actor_mean repair on selected same-line proposal deltas
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: objective-sanity implementation only; no PPO, training, checkpoint artifact, closed-loop gate, promotion, private holdout, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if primary alpha 0.2 cannot be improved
stop if checkpoint artifacts are written
stop if base interpolation is used for repair
stop if diagnostics or donor-plus guardrails fail
stop after implementation for mandatory result audit
fallback_plan: route to result audit whether implementation passes or fails
if actor_mean scope is insufficient, audit before any wider-scope design
if primary passes, audit before checkpoint artifact or replay design
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1652 admits one selected-proposal repair implementation

admission_evidence: M1650 selected proposal candidates as metadata
M1652 pre-registers candidate set and repair gates
allowed_updates: selected-proposal repair module or extension and focused tests
M1653 docs status queue scoreboard research log and review
next_stage_criteria: selected proposal repair metrics are written
audit route is explicit before checkpoint artifact or replay route

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1653 tests fixed-tensor selected-proposal repair and cannot prove history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: evaluates correct/wrong hidden exact residual repair only; no new closed-loop history intervention
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1362, M1630, M1650, M1651, and M1652 public artifacts only.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If selected-proposal repair fails, classify scope/optimizer failure and audit before any rerun or wider scope.
allowed_claims: bounded no-checkpoint selected-proposal exact repair result
no PPO, no promotion, no private-holdout, no paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: Actor_mean-only damped projection can reduce contour-aware exact residual on at least the smallest selected real same-line proposal delta without checkpoint artifacts.
success_criteria: training_started_count ppo_used_count promoted_count private_holdout_used_count actor_input_contract_changed_count level3_self_id_claim_count are 0
failure_criteria: selected proposal candidates differ from design without audit
primary alpha 0.2 is not measurable or cannot be improved
base interpolation is used for repair
diagnostics or donor-plus actions enter the loss target
PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes or level3 claims are produced

commands.name: focused_tests
commands.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest -q tests/test_selected_proposal_repair.py

commands.name: run_repair
commands.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m autodrift.selected_proposal_repair --base-checkpoint runs/m1362_bidirectional_active_set_interpolation_preflight/checkpoints/alpha_0_1.pt --candidate-summary runs/m1650_proposal_source_preflight/candidate_summary.csv --materialization-run-dir runs/m1630_contour_aware_full_target_materialization --run-dir runs/m1653_selected_proposal_repair --selected-alphas 0.2,0.4,1.0

decision_rule: M1653 passes if the selected-proposal no-checkpoint repair reduces at least the primary alpha 0.2 exact residual with clean guardrails.
